hooks.command: for p in "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.venv/Scripts/python.exe" "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.venv/bin/python" python3 python py; do "$p" -c "import sys; sys.exit(sys.version_info < (3, 8))" >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec "$p" "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/hooks/guard_padlocks.py"; done; echo "Heron padlock guard: no Python found, so this step was not checked." >&2; exit 1
